facts.fact: Loi n°14-029/AU on protection of personal data (68 articles) was deliberated and adopted by the Assembly in plenary session on 26 June 2014; the text carries no promulgation date or decree.
facts.system: Loi n°14-029/AU portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: Article 19 of the law institutes a Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés (CNIL) whose nine members are named by decree under Article 24; the text records no appointment.
